=== Publication sources ===
* '''Source publication''' ([[Visored Vision (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 2, slip 23 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “USED: If opponent has 3 (or more) non-battleground locations on table, activate 5 Force. LOST: ▼ one battleground location.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•23” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-23-Visored_Vision-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''Source publication''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 23), in the Committee's Remaster template: “USED: If opponent has three non-battleground locations on table, activate 5 Force. LOST: Deploy a battleground location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
|hatnote=This is the current (Remaster) text of this Virtual Original card. For the original 30 May 2003 slip, see [[Visored Vision (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Visored Vision]].
